Use case: ui-mockup.
Visual direction "Quiet": calm, minimal, focused on reading and listening, in the spirit of Apple's own apps and ChatGPT voice mode.
Dark theme: soft graphite background (#111315-ish), slightly lighter panels, hairline dividers, near-white text, muted grey secondary text.
Light theme: warm paper white (#F7F6F3-ish), white panels, light grey hairlines, near-black text.
Accents: German = warm amber (#E8A33D-ish), English = calm teal (#2BB3A3-ish); used sparingly (active tab, waveform, language badge, primary button).
Shapes: radii 12–16, almost no shadows (one very soft elevation for floating panels), thin 1.5-px line icons.
Waveform: a single thin flowing line in the session's language accent.
Lingo mark: a simple rounded geometric glyph (two overlapping speech-wave arcs forming an abstract "L"), monochrome with the accent tint.
Exact palette override for Quiet: dark background #111315, sidebar #16191C, card #1D2125, assistant #20262A, learner #29241C, primary text #F5F4F0, secondary text #B5BBC1, muted text #9DA5AC, border #343A40, German text/wave #F2B85B, English #62D5C5. Light background #F7F6F3, sidebar #F0EFEB, cards #FFFFFF, assistant #FFFFFF, learner #F3E9D9, primary text #202428, secondary #505A63, muted #59636B, border #D3D7D9, German text/wave #855107, English #136C61. Accent buttons use dark foreground in dark theme and white foreground in light theme; no low-contrast white-on-yellow. Exact geometry where applicable: sidebar 232pt, hints 272pt, center remaining; 4pt grid; margin 24pt, bubble padding16pt; title24pt, body16pt, caption12pt; radii12pt. Simple two rounded arcs form the abstract Lingo L mark, no robot, no person.
Create ONE new final production reference, using the attached board for style only. Do not copy the board composition. Theme: dark. Output exactly 1536 by 1024 pixels.
A macOS desktop app window (traffic-light buttons top-left, no menu bar, no desktop wallpaper), 1280×800 points, shown alone on a neutral background matching the theme.
Sidebar: Lingo mark and «Lingo», navigation «Сегодня», «Разговоры», «Словарь», «Прогресс», «Учитель»; sessions «У врача», «IELTS Part 2», «Работа: собеседование». Bottom «Настройки». Three columns, full conversation centered. Header «У врача · Немецкий · B1», source «Groq · 120b». Assistant «Guten Morgen! Was führt Sie heute zu mir?». Learner «Ich habe seit zwei Tage Kopfschmerzen.»; inside THAT learner bubble strike through only «Tage» and place «Tagen» immediately next to it. Assistant «Das tut mir leid. Haben Sie auch Fieber?». Hint cards «Ich habe Kopfschmerzen.» / «У меня болит голова.» and «Seit wann haben Sie Fieber?» / «С какого времени у вас температура?». No separate correction bubble. Bottom compact voice panel «Говорю», waveform, «Пауза», «Завершить», «По-русски», «Медленно». Text field «Напишите сообщение…». Right column «Подсказки», tabs «Фразы темы», «Исправления», «Как сказать», «Словарь ★». At 1280×800pt the sidebar/hints start at x=0 and x=1008; center width776pt. Entire app window visible, aligned rectangle, no perspective. Window 1100×800pt; hide right column and replace with book icon; preserve reading width.
High-fidelity UI design mockup, flat front view, pixel-crisp, realistic production app (not a concept-art poster).
Typography: SF Pro (Apple system font), crisp and fully legible Cyrillic and Latin text, correct Russian spelling.
Only the text given in «» quotes may appear, exactly as written; no lorem ipsum, no extra labels, no watermarks, no real brand logos.
Consistent 4-pt spacing grid, generous whitespace, clear visual hierarchy, accessible contrast (WCAG AA, 4.5:1 for body text).
German content uses the German accent colour, English content the English accent colour (see style). No country flags.
No pronunciation scores, no accent meters, no star ratings of speech.
Render each explicitly quoted string verbatim, retaining Cyrillic/Latin characters, umlauts, punctuation and case. Other than Lingo, DE, EN, 9:41, synthetic date/time labels specifically quoted, and explicitly named provider/model strings, do not invent text. No decorative city art. All data are synthetic. No pronunciation assessment or speech rating. Text and a compact waveform stay central. Do not enlarge an avatar to replace the conversation.

FINAL TEXT REPAIR (§7): prioritize readable exact lettering over decoration. Render every required quoted UI string, in its original language, exactly. Missing strings in the preceding attempt were: ["Guten Morgen! Was führt Sie heute zu mir?", "Подсказки", "Фразы темы", "Исправления", "Как сказать"]. Make room for these labels; never substitute a glyph or icon for a required word. Keep the Quiet thin outline double-loop mark, identical across themes. No giant orb, no robot, no pronunciation assessment. For a narrow Mac collapsed hints may be a clearly labeled expandable control; the first assistant utterance and two hint phrases still need a readable place. Keep the full original wrong and corrected words for the inline correction, showing Tage struck through followed by Tagen. Do not invent any extra text.
